compute_iou: compute the intersection over union (IoU) between two bounding boxes in xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax format
calculate_loc_accuracy: calculate localization accuracy and top-1 accuracy for a batch of predicted bounding boxes against ground truth
evaluate_detection_boxes: evaluate detection bounding boxes by computing IoU scores and measuring how many exceed a threshold
measure_top1_localization: measure top-1 localization accuracy combining classification correctness with bounding box IoU threshold
review_iou_function: review the iou function that computes intersection over union for two bounding boxes using area overlap
